evidence.notes: Database.insert(allOrNone=false) rejects a value outside a restricted picklist's active metadata values.

source.content: @isTest private class RestrictedPicklistDmlTest { @isTest static void invalidRestrictedPicklistReturnsFieldError() { Database.SaveResult result = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'Acme', Status__c = 'Bogus'), false); System.assertEquals(false, result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('INVALID_OR_NULL_FOR_RESTRICTED_PICKLIST', result.getErrors()[0].getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Status__c', result.getErrors()[0].getFields()[0]); System.assertEquals(0, [SELECT Id FROM Account].size()); } }
